statements.impact_statement: Measured 2026-11-17 on NetBird v0.83.1. The fix (pion/stun commit fa9f074a33, 'Fix panic on short XOR-MAPPED-ADDRESS value', released in 3.1.5) moves the len(value) <= 4 check in XORMappedAddress.GetFromAs ahead of the read of the address family. Every fixed stun release moves to pion/transport v4, whose types NetBird's client passes into stun (client/internal/relay/relay.go), so the module stays at v3.1.0 and the build applies that exact change to the vendored copy: apps/<image>/stun-v3.1.0-xoraddr.patch, patched in melange.yaml with go mod vendor and built with -mod=vendor, and the build fails unless the check sits before the family read. The vulnerable code is therefore not in the binary. Revisit when NetBird moves to pion/stun 3.1.5 or later.
